WITH retail_tenants AS (
    SELECT id, name
    FROM tenants
    WHERE name IN (
        'Kibblewick', 'Studio Vrij', 'Petalcourt Beauty',
        'Marrowby & Vane', 'Cragsley Outfitters', 'Ampfeld Elektronik'
    )
),
all_orders AS (
    SELECT o.id, o.tenant_id, o.user_id, o.placed_at
    FROM orders o
    JOIN retail_tenants rt ON rt.id = o.tenant_id
    WHERE o.placed_at IS NOT NULL
),
base_orders AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM all_orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01'
),
order_has_return AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT order_id
    FROM order_returns
),
next_order_per_base_order AS (
    SELECT b.id AS order_id, MIN(a.placed_at) AS next_placed_at
    FROM base_orders b
    JOIN all_orders a
      ON a.tenant_id = b.tenant_id
     AND a.user_id = b.user_id
     AND a.placed_at > b.placed_at
    GROUP BY b.id
),
order_level AS (
    SELECT
        b.id AS order_id,
        b.tenant_id,
        b.user_id,
        CASE WHEN ohr.order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'has_return' ELSE 'no_return' END AS grp,
        CASE WHEN nop.next_placed_at IS NOT NULL
             THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (nop.next_placed_at - b.placed_at)) / 86400.0
        END AS days_to_next
    FROM base_orders b
    LEFT JOIN order_has_return ohr ON ohr.order_id = b.id
    LEFT JOIN next_order_per_base_order nop ON nop.order_id = b.id
)
SELECT
    grp AS "group",
    COUNT(*) AS orders_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT (tenant_id, user_id)) AS distinct_customers,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN days_to_next IS NOT NULL AND days_to_next <= 90 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
        1
    ) AS pct_with_subsequent_order_within_90_days,
    ROUND(
        CAST(
            PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_to_next)
            FILTER (WHERE days_to_next IS NOT NULL AND days_to_next <= 90)
        AS numeric),
        0
    ) AS median_days_to_subsequent_order
FROM order_level
GROUP BY grp
ORDER BY CASE WHEN grp = 'has_return' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
note: "Subsequent order" is defined as each order's nearest next order placed by the same (tenant_id, user_id), regardless of that next order's own date range (it can fall after 2025-09-30, since data runs through 2025-12-31); the 90-day and median calculations use that nearest next order's date, not just any order in the window. Return status/outcome of the order_returns row is not filtered (any row counts as "has a return").
